question: How many High Energy Physics - Lattice articles listed in January 2020 on Arxiv had ps versions available?

history.name: Orchestrator

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Before we do that, FileSurfer, open README.md to see how ps_available was inferred and whether it undercounts cases where PS is only accessible via a secondary link.

history.name: FileSurfer
history.content:

- Limitation: If PS is only available behind a multi-file HTML page (some author-supplied cases), the script may fail to flag ps_available True unless a direct ps link is present.
- Coverage: CSV likely undercounts true PS availability by an estimated 10-20% for months with more author-supplied PS.

history.name: Assistant

mistake_reason: At step 1, the orchestrator explicitly chose to rely on FileSurfer and local datasets instead of directing WebSurfer to the live arXiv pages for January 2020 hep-lat listings. This constitutes a Tool Selection Error (FM-4.3) because the task inherently requires checking current arXiv pages for PS availability per entry, while FileSurfer is limited to local, potentially incomplete and biased snapshots. Persisting with FileSurfer led to extrapolations and compromises rather than accurate counts, ultimately producing an incorrect answer.
